name: Quizlet AI
tagline: Quizlet is the world's largest student learning platform with 700 million study sets. Its AI features include Q-Chat (an AI tutor that practises with students), Magic Notes (which auto-generates flashcards from uploaded notes), and personalised study plans that adapt to each student's weak areas.
